parameters.content:
## AI CORE
The brain of the system. Understands user intent, decides whether to research or generate visuals, writes captions/scripts, and routes tasks to Blotato nodes.

## RESEARCH ENGINE (Blotato)
Creates a research task in Blotato, extracts structured insights, and returns clean data ready for content generation.

## MEDIA ENGINE (Blotato)
Generates visual assets.Creates infographics or slideshow videos based on structured content.

## DISTRIBUTION (Blotato)
Publishes generated content directly to Instagram and LinkedIn.

## RESPONSE
Sends confirmation back to Telegram.

# 🛠️ Workflow Setup Guide  

Author: [GiangxAI](https://www.youtube.com/@giangxai.official)

---

## How it works

- A user sends a topic or content request directly to your Telegram Bot to trigger the workflow  
- The AI Core analyzes user intent, references conversation memory, and decides which automation steps to activate  
- A Source job is created to collect and structure real-world information  
- The workflow waits for processing and validates extracted data  
- Structured content is sent to Blotato to generate visuals (infographic or slideshow video)  
- The workflow waits for media rendering to complete  
- The final visual asset is retrieved and verified  
- The generated content is automatically published to:
  - Instagram  
  - LinkedIn  
- A confirmation message is sent back to Telegram once publishing is successful  

The entire pipeline runs using an async orchestration pattern:

Trigger → Analyze → Create → Wait → Retrieve → Publish → Confirm  

Once configured, the system turns Telegram messages into fully automated multi-platform content — from research to publishing — without manual editing or uploading.

---

## Setup guide [n8n](https://n8n.partnerlinks.io/giangxai)

- Configure the **Telegram Bot Trigger** node with your bot token  
- Connect Gemini (or AI model) credentials for intent analysis  
- Add conversation memory storage for contextual responses  
- Connect ** [Blotato](https://blotato.com/?ref=giang9s) API credentials** for research, media generation, and publishing  
- Configure Instagram and LinkedIn credentials for auto publishing  
- Review status routing logic (processing / completed / failed)  
- Adjust wait timing based on AI and rendering speed  

After setup, the entire workflow runs automatically from a single Telegram interface — no manual research, design work, or cross-platform posting required.

## TRIGGER
Receives content requests from Telegram and starts the workflow.

## 🤖 Agent Modérateur Facebook — OpenAI

### Variables à configurer (Settings → Variables) :
| Variable | Description |
|---|---|
| `FB_PAGE_TOKEN` | Token d'accès Page Facebook |
| `PAGE_CONTEXT` | Contexte/persona de votre page |
| `BANNED_KEYWORDS` | Mots à supprimer (séparés par virgule) |
| `REPLY_LANG` | Langue des réponses (ex: français) |
| `GOOGLE_SHEET_ID` | ID du Google Sheet (journal) |
| `SLACK_CHANNEL` | Canal Slack (ex: #moderation) |

### Credentials à ajouter :
- **OpenAI API** → nœud AI Agent
- **Google Sheets OAuth2** → nœud journal
- **Slack API** → nœud notification

### Config Facebook Webhook :
1. developers.facebook.com → Webhooks → Page
2. URL : votre URL webhook n8n
3. Verify token : `n8n_fb_moderator`
4. Champ à activer : `feed`
